Name: (CP) Lewis Loves Blueberries
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Have you ever seen that one dialogue where Lewis directly asks you about blueberries being grown on your farm? Did you then go and give him a blueberry, only to be disappointed when he doesn't actually love said blueberry?

Well that was me, and it annoyed me to no end, and I promptly realized today as that happened, that I could just... change that. So I did. 

Now Lewis actually loves the blueberries he goes out of his way to ask you about.

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]

Manifest.Name: Lewis Loves Blueberries
Manifest.Description: Changes Lewis' gift preference so that he loves blueberries.
Manifest.Author: AngelOfStars
